+            "agentAliasId": "alias-12345",
+            "sessionId": "session-123",
+            "inputText": "Hi",

replies.body:
This ended up catching an issue that a caller-side raise or break from inside a bare for loop never ended the span. This is because when that happens none of the finalization methods (__exit__, close) are hit..  

To fix this we added a method `_StreamTelemetry__del__` which gets invoked when the object is garbage collected.. Note that when the object is garbage collected is dependent on the users code, and also the exception is lost (if there was an exception, a break also causes the issue), it doesn't reach the wrapper

+    session_id = api_params.get("sessionId")

+    # InvokeAgent takes an alias, not a version, and the response doesn't report the
+    # version the alias resolved to. The alias is the closest available identifier of
+    # which agent revision served the request.
+    agent_alias_id = api_params.get("agentAliasId")
+    if agent_alias_id:
+        invocation.agent_version = str(agent_alias_id)
+
+    if capture_content:

+        if input_text is not None:
